channel.title: Local News Wire Broadcast Feed
channel.description: Approved local stories in broadcast order

item.description: Lake Champlain’s lake monster, Champ, will appear on a twenty twenty-seven USPS mythical creature stamp. It will be one of five creatures featured on forever stamps. The Postal Service has not announced the release date or locations yet.

Governor Phil Scott is urging Vermonters to clean up political signs left along state highways after the election. The Vermont Agency of Transportation will start removing signs from rights-of-way soon. Unclaimed signs will be recycled for free by Casella Waste Systems after thirty days.

Killington is seeking to fill key municipal jobs amid state concerns over financial oversight. The town faces challenges managing Tax Increment Financing funds due to staffing shortages. Efforts continue to hire permanent staff and address accounting issues.

Vermont officials warn hunters after chronic wasting disease was found in a wild deer in western New York. The disease is fatal and spreads through abnormal proteins that are hard to destroy. Hunters cannot bring unprocessed deer or use deer urine-based scents in Vermont.
